overall_quality.evidence: Eventual consistency is a property of distributed data storage systems where data is replicated across multiple nodes. It ensures that all nodes will eventually agree on the latest state of the data, but it doesn't guarantee that all nodes will be in sync at any given moment. This means that there can be temporary inconsistencies, and it's important to design systems that can handle these inconsistencies gracefully.
